summary: Phase 2 Jaleter Legacy BUILD math verification (specs #3, #4, #5) — ALL CHECKS PASS for changed code. Legacy card & drill sheet fully renamed from 'Monthly Budget Surplus' → 'Monthly Budget Net' (testID legacy-surplus-drill still opens the sheet as spec'd). BUILD math toggle now shows per-month composition line ('1 budgeted · 11 estimated (carry-forward).' for 1yr; '1 budgeted · 59 estimated (carry-forward).' for 5yr) and narrative reads 'held flat (no assumed return)'. Negative-net UI simulation not feasible in-place (Budget/Activity screens show 'No accounts linked / No transactions yet') — but with all zeros, 5yr BUILD correctly shows $0 (starting cash 0 + investments 0 held flat + 0 net × 60mo = $0) and did not crash. action_items: None required — Phase 2 Legacy BUILD math changes (specs #3/#4/#5) verified in-code and in-UI for the parts that render on an all-zero test account.

Optional: to fully exercise the Home Legacy Snapshot teaser & negative-BUILD path, seed alex+test1 with a non-zero Budget (e.g. income $100, expense $200 → monthlyNet -$100).
